items.text:
It's fun, although trying to find the ship seller / transponder repair dude is infuriating. I was loving the game until this issue and now I'm grinding to a halt trying to figure it out. Here's hoping I figure it out soon.

Update: After days of searching I figured out that the Ship Broker is a Kiosk, not a person......... Anyway, looking forward to having fun again!
items.text_zh:
挺有趣的，不过试图找到卖船的人/应答器修理员简直让人抓狂。在这个问题之前我一直很喜欢这款游戏，现在我在努力弄清楚的过程中卡住了。希望我能很快搞明白。

更新：找了几天之后，我发现飞船经纪商是一个自助终端，不是一个人.........总之，期待再次享受乐趣！
